name: pcb-designer-app
description:
PCB Designer AI turns your natural-language hardware description into a complete KiCad project. Describe what you want to build and the app will: parse your requirements using AI, generate a Bill of Materials, synthesise a KiCad schematic, place and route the board, and package everything — .kicad_pcb, .kicad_sch, BOM, and Gerbers — into a ready-to-download ZIP.

⚠️ Requires a Local Agent with KiCad 8 installed. The routing and Gerber-export steps use KiCad's pcbnew Python API which is only available on the user's own machine. The app cannot run on a Cloud Agent.
about:
PCB Designer AI turns your natural-language hardware description into a complete KiCad project. Describe what you want to build and the app will: parse your requirements using AI, generate a Bill of Materials, synthesise a KiCad schematic, place and route the board, and package everything — .kicad_pcb, .kicad_sch, BOM, and Gerbers — into a ready-to-download ZIP.

⚠️ Requires a Local Agent with KiCad 8 installed. The routing and Gerber-export steps use KiCad's pcbnew Python API which is only available on the user's own machine. The app cannot run on a Cloud Agent.

Setup:
1. Install KiCad 8 from https://www.kicad.org/download/
2. Ensure the KiCad Python libraries are accessible (they are installed automatically with KiCad 8 on all platforms).
3. Run the app from a Local Anna Agent — it will call pcbnew automatically.

What changes with different inputs:
- The BOM, component references, and net topology change with every new description.
- The schematic and board layout are re-generated from scratch for each run.
- The output ZIP always reflects the current user prompt.
